name: MNPI and deal data (MAR)
name_ar: معلومات جوهرية غير معلنة وبيانات الصفقات

rules.note: containment is a market-integrity control: no consent, no subject-access right, no anonymisation cure

rules.quote: the duty to maintain the insider list, not an access rule

rules.citation: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1291 of 12 June 2026 (repeals (EU) 2022/1210), applies from 5 July 2026

rules.quote: a buy-side firm leaking deal data breaches §204A, not Reg FD
deal codenames are ubiquitous practice but no rule names them

ar.brief: يطلب {requester} {what} من {deployment}. {delta} يحتوي على {direct_count} معرّف(ات) مباشرة، حجب النظام منها {masked_count}، و{freetext_count} حقل(حقول) نص حر لم يحجبها. سيكشف هذا الإفراج عن {below_threshold} سجل(سجلات) دون الحد الأدنى. لن يخرج أي شيء آخر من {deployment}. إذا وافقت، يحتفظ به {recipient} لمدة {retention} ويجب أن يعيد إثبات الإتلاف. أنت توقّع بصفتك {reviewer}.
ar.delta_new: لا يوجد إفراج سابق مماثل؛ هذا شكل جديد.
ar.delta_same: له الشكل نفسه للإفراج الذي أجزته في {prior_date}، مع تغيّر {changed} قيمة/قيم.
ar.reject_hint: الرفض لا يحتاج إلى سبب. الموافقة فوق المستوى الأساسي تحتاج إلى سبب مكتوب بكلماتك.
ar.verdict_hidden: حكم الآلة مختوم تحت الالتزام {commitment} وسيُعرض بعد أن تقرّر.

en.brief: {requester} is asking for {what} from {deployment}. {delta} It contains {direct_count} direct identifier(s), of which {masked_count} the system has already masked, and {freetext_count} free-text field(s), which it has not. This release would expose {below_threshold} record(s) below the threshold. Nothing else from {deployment} would leave. If you approve it, {recipient} holds it for {retention} and must return proof of destruction. You are signing as {reviewer}.
en.delta_new: There is no comparable earlier release; this is a new shape.
en.delta_same: It is the same shape as the release you cleared on {prior_date}, with {changed} value(s) changed.
en.does_not_stop: What this grade does not stop: {clause}
en.reject_hint: Rejecting needs no reason. Approving above the baseline tier needs your own typed reason.
en.verdict_hidden: The machine's finding is sealed under commitment {commitment} and will be shown after you decide.
